_meta.method: Aggregated from MSPD Table III, one row per CUSIP (first-row outstanding_amt). Coupons: notes, bonds and TIPS use the stated coupon (TIPS = real coupon); bills use the issued-amount-weighted auction yield; FRNs use the current 3-month bill rate plus each FRN's spread. Amounts are face value; TIPS include inflation compensation.
_meta.source: Treasury, Monthly Statement of the Public Debt, Table III (Detail of Marketable Treasury Securities), 2026-09-30
_meta.note: Bills and FRNs auctioned after the record date are not included, so bars beyond ~12 months show only securities already issued. Treasury will add new bills and notes on top as it refinances.
